messages:
jess (PM): Planning a Private rollout for AzuraLogix on Redwood Private. Proposed window: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. No customer-visible downtime expected. Requesting approvals: Eng, SRE, Security, AE. Details below.

deploy-bot: Release plan created: rollout_id=rl-azura-20260402, canary=5%, canary_duration=15m, rollout_strategy=linear-5-25-50, artifacts pinned: model=redwood-v4.0-quant, runtime=1.12.3. CI checks: green.

oliver (SRE): Quick Qs — what are rollback criteria? Who has permission to abort mid-canary? Also need a healthcheck window and tracing enabled for first 30m.

jess (PM): Rollback thresholds: P95 latency increase >25% vs baseline OR error rate >1% sustained for 5m -> auto-rollback. Manual abort by oncall + release lead. We'll enable tracing and verbose logs for 30m.

mira (Infra): Confirming infra capacity: Dedicated pool will be drained and traffic routed to Private cluster during swap. Any KV-cache warmup plan?

jess (PM): KV-cache prewarm with the latest prefix sets; we'll run warmup job 45m prior. No model parameter changes besides quantization; cache key schema unchanged.

nina (Security): Need KMS access audit and HSM key rotation window documented. Are we sending customer keys through migration?

jess (PM): No key migration. Customer-managed KMS stays in place. I'll attach the KMS audit note to the customer ticket and DM ops for a quick review.

aaron (AE): AzuraLogix asks about an ETA for read-only fallback and whether embeddings will be impacted. They want a short heads-up to their infra team.

jess (PM): Read-only fallback expected for ~90s during model swap on the control-plane side only; embeddings service unaffected. We'll send customer pre-notice 24h and 1h before window.

sam (Oncall): I approve from oncall side with the following conditions: canary 5% -> 15m -> escalate if any 5m error spikes; verbose logs on; tracer sampling at 100% for first 10m then 10%. :thumbsup:

jess (PM): Noted. Adding tracer sampling config.

deploy-bot: Rollout config preview:
```yaml
rollout_id: rl-azura-20260402
canary: 5%
canary_duration: 15m
steps: [5,25,50,100]
model: redwood-v4.0-quant
hotfix_fallback: redwood-v3.9-fp16
metrics:
  latency_p95_threshold: 1.25s
  error_rate_threshold: 1%
  evaluation_window: 5m
logging:
  verbose: true
  trace_sampling: 100%->10% after 10m
```

oliver (SRE): The hotfix_fallback looks good. Requesting a canary region split: 3% us-east1, 2% europe-west1 to exercise routing. Can we ensure cross-region fallbacks are tested?

jess (PM): Yes — canary will be split across regions like you specified. I'll update the runbook.

nina (Security): Approved pending KMS audit note in the ticket (I need the audit attachment before the window).

aaron (AE): I will send the customer pre-notice draft by EOD.

sam (Oncall): Final +1 from oncall. Ready to abort if thresholds trip.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z -> rollout_id=rl-azura-20260402. Reminder set for 24h and 1h. Canary observers: sam, oliver, jess.

jess (PM): All approvals collected (SRE, Infra, Security, AE, Oncall). Final step: eng-releases, please mark as approved for execution and assign deploy window owner.

oliver (SRE): I'll own the window and watch the canary. Marking approved.

jess (PM): Thanks — deploying per schedule. I'll post the runbook link and pre-notice once aaron confirms the customer message. :rocket:
